name: opencode-command-center
description: Independent control plane for isolating, operating, and verifying OpenCode agent workflows

scripts.test:lab: node --test scripts/lab/*.test.mjs scripts/local-preview/*.test.mjs scripts/opencode-tui-merge.test.mjs scripts/opencode-preferences.test.mjs scripts/opencode-routing.test.mjs
scripts.lab:browser:setup: npm install playwright@1.55.0 --no-save && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.quality:test: node --test scripts/opencode-routing.test.mjs scripts/opencode-tooling.test.mjs scripts/artifacts/*.test.mjs scripts/quality-lib.test.mjs scripts/quality-mcp/*.test.mjs scripts/quality/*.test.mjs scripts/github/*.test.mjs docker/agent-gateway/*.test.mjs docker/notion-publisher/*.test.mjs scripts/lab/*.test.mjs scripts/local-preview/*.test.mjs scripts/opencode-tui-merge.test.mjs scripts/opencode-preferences.test.mjs
scripts.quality:coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=85 --test-coverage-branches=60 --test-coverage-functions=90 --test-coverage-include=docker/agent-gateway/capability-lease.mjs --test-coverage-include=scripts/github/publish-boundary.mjs --test-coverage-include=scripts/opencode-preferences.mjs --test-coverage-include=scripts/lab/preview-launch-policy.mjs --test-coverage-include=scripts/lab/loopback-health.mjs --test-coverage-include=scripts/release/module-budget.mjs docker/agent-gateway/capability-lease.test.mjs scripts/github/publish-boundary.test.mjs scripts/opencode-preferences.test.mjs scripts/lab/opencode-launcher.test.mjs scripts/lab/loopback-health.test.mjs scripts/release/module-budget.test.mjs
scripts.quality:eval:test: if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run --project quality/inspect python -m unittest discover -s quality/inspect/tests -p 'test_*.py'; elif [ -x quality/inspect/.venv/bin/python ]; then quality/inspect/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s quality/inspect/tests -p 'test_*.py'; else python3 -m unittest discover -s quality/inspect/tests -p 'test_*.py'; fi
scripts.quality:eval: uv run --project quality/inspect inspect eval quality/inspect/evals/agent_quality.py --log-dir quality/inspect/logs --max-retries 2 --timeout 120 --time-limit 180 --max-tokens 2000 --max-connections 4 -M responses_api=false -M background=false
scripts.quality:eval:trajectory: uv run --project quality/inspect inspect eval quality/inspect/evals/trajectory_quality.py --log-dir quality/inspect/logs --max-retries 2 --timeout 120 --time-limit 180 --max-tokens 2000 --max-connections 4 -M responses_api=false -M background=false
scripts.check: oxfmt --check . && npm run quality:modules && npm run typecheck && npm run test:lab && npm run test:hound && npm run quality:test && npm run quality:coverage
